tools.name: klaviyo_get_account
tools.description: Get the Klaviyo account the private API key belongs to (name, contact information, industry, timezone). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/accounts.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_lists
tools.description: List the account's lists (static audiences used for sends, flow triggers and signup forms), with names and creation dates. GET /api/lists.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_list
tools.description: Get one list by id, with its name and timestamps. GET /api/lists/{id}.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list
tools.description: List the profiles (contacts) that belong to one list, with their email, phone and properties. GET /api/lists/{id}/profiles.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_profiles
tools.description: List profiles (contacts). Filter by email, phone_number, external_id or id, e.g. equals(email,"a@example.com"). Returns personal data: use only for the account owner's own contacts. GET /api/profiles.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_profile
tools.description: Get one profile (contact) by id with its attributes and properties. GET /api/profiles/{id}.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_segments
tools.description: List the account's segments (dynamic audiences defined by conditions), with names and timestamps. GET /api/segments.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns with name, status and timestamps. Filter by name, archived, builder, created_at or updated_at, e.g. contains(name,"Black Friday"). GET /api/campaigns.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: name, status, send time and audience settings. GET /api/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_flows
tools.description: List automation flows with name, status (live, draft, manual) and trigger type. Filter by name, status or archived, e.g. equals(status,"live"). GET /api/flows.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_flow
tools.description: Get one flow by id: name, status, trigger type and timestamps. GET /api/flows/{id}.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_metrics
tools.description: List the metrics (event types such as Placed Order or Opened Email) that the account tracks. Use the metric ids in klaviyo_list_events. GET /api/metrics.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_events
tools.description: List tracked events (activity such as orders or email opens). Filter by metric_id, profile_id or datetime, e.g. equals(metric_id,"ABC123"). Returns personal data: use only for the account owner's own contacts. GET /api/events.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_templates
tools.description: List the account's email and SMS templates with names and timestamps. GET /api/templates.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_tags
tools.description: List the account's tags, which group campaigns, flows and lists. GET /api/tags.

tools.name: klaviyo_create_list
tools.description: Create a new empty list with the given name. Creates a record only; it sends nothing. POST /api/lists.

tools.name: klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list
tools.description: Add existing profiles to a list by profile id (max 100 per call). Does not change consent. Adding a profile can trigger flows that start on list membership. POST /api/lists/{id}/relationships/profiles.

tools.name: klaviyo_create_profile
tools.description: Create a profile (contact) from email, phone, names, external id and custom properties. It does not subscribe the contact to marketing. Klaviyo returns 409 if the profile exists. POST /api/profiles.

tools.name: klaviyo_update_profile
tools.description: Update the given fields of one profile by id. Fields you omit stay unchanged. PATCH /api/profiles/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_list_metrics, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_list_templates, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list · Private data: klaviyo_get_account, klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_get_profile, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_create_profile · Public sink: klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_get_campaign, klaviyo_list_metrics, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_list_templates, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list, klaviyo_create_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_list_metrics, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_list_templates, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list · Private data: klaviyo_get_account, klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_get_profile, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_create_profile · Public sink: klaviyo_list_profiles_in_list, klaviyo_list_profiles, klaviyo_get_campaign, klaviyo_list_metrics, klaviyo_list_events, klaviyo_list_templates, klaviyo_create_list, klaviyo_add_profiles_to_list, klaviyo_create_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
